name: std::common_type<std::chrono::time_point>
intro: Exposes the type named type, which is the common type of two std::chrono::time_points.

sections.title: Member types
sections.text:

 type

 std::chrono::time_point<Clock, typename std::common_type<Duration1, Duration2>::type>

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The common type of two std::chrono::time_point types is a std::chrono::time_point with the same clock as the two types and the std::common_type of their durations.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: A timestamp starts at 10 seconds since its clock's epoch; add and subtract durations.
